title: Bernard Schwartz House, 3425 Adams Street, Two Rivers, Manitowoc County, WI
notes: Significance: In 1938, Frank Lloyd Wright published the design for a contemporary house in Life magazine, as part of an article titled "Eight Houses for Modern Living." An outstanding example of one of Wright's Usonian houses, the scheme was subsequently adapted by Wright for Two Rivers businessman Bernard Schwartz and his wife, Fern, and completed in spring 1940.
